notes.title: Broken Ties Patch 1.2
notes.content:
A ton of balance changes, typo fixes, bug squashing and more! 

Several enemies give more XP.
Lamia's Song Item is now awarded at the appropriate time. Added Lamia's Soul to the original location.
Fixed some weird geography.
Fixed a glitch where you could keep challenging the minotaur.
Fixed a glitch where you could keep triggering a plot conversation in the Council and the Sewers.
Fixed an issue where Captain Danowitz would work for free.

The Imp Statue is a bit less greedy.
Changed Ultimate Seal on Darengor to be unlocked at Level 18.
Corbin's Log Page 2 can now be found.

Should be a much smoother experience!

notes.title: Broken Ties Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Bats are less obnoxious.
Hornets are less angry.
Spider Venom has been diluted.

notes.title: Sales and a Walktrough
notes.content:
Hello, this is the first Dev Update! 

Broken Ties is discounted for both the August and Winter Steam Sales, and I'm working on adding a Walkthrough to the game to unveil loot, side quests, and strategies.

notes.title: Broken Ties is live!
notes.content:
Hello all players! As of today, April the 13th (a day that is most certainly spooky) Broken Ties is live! 

For anyone who needs help with the game, you may email me at tninjadev@mail.com 
or post a message on 
https://twitter.com/BrokenTies_Help

I will likely post any problems sent to me and then fixed or any questions with needed answers on to twitter, as well as responding to any emails.

Thank you!
